name: MCTPC-1501X
tagline: 15.0-inch 1024 x 768 industrial panel PC with four platform options
description: MCTPC-1501X combines a 15.0-inch 1024 x 768 capacitive display with Intel J1900 or Core 3rd–8th Gen platform options. Dual Gigabit Ethernet and two RS-232/RS-485 COM ports support equipment integration. The front panel is IP65-rated; standard power is 12V DC, with an optional 9–36V Phoenix terminal. Memory, USB and storage specifications are listed separately for each platform.
